title: Recover interrupted desktop updates
summary: Desktop updates now recover from temporary network interruptions with bounded retries and clearer local diagnostics. Update packages remain Tauri-signed; this release does not include Apple Developer ID signing, macOS notarization or Windows publisher signing.
items: Update checks retry temporary connection failures within a fixed time budget, while certificate, manifest and signature failures remain blocking errors.

Interrupted update downloads can retry once from fresh bytes, recheck the selected release and verify the package signature before installation becomes available. Cancellation remains responsive during requests and retry delays.
Local rotating update logs record sanitized cause chains, attempt counts, timing and recovery results without storing credentials or response contents.
Shared settings navigation is clearer, and the public footer includes a support email contact.
Release publication verifies draft assets by release ID and supports recovery of verified download alias publication.
